scientific_integrity: All-characteristic assertions have an elementary ideal identity and point-count proof; finite enumeration and symbolic Groebner comparisons are corroborating checks, not substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Classifies the one-sided zero-product scheme only in strict upper-triangular size four, not arbitrary size, the two-sided annihilating scheme, conjugacy classes, or all flagged complexes. Full-text assessment of Chen--Wang (2016) remains a historical-priority risk.
title: Four components and the first dimension jump in flagged one-sided zero-product pairs
